nodes.statement: Recover the exact source and establish the smallest coherent Native Instrument implementation slice.
The new experience profile changes persisted settings and live semantic resources while legacy users are repaired to safe appearance and onboarding defaults.
First launch now presents a modal review flow and compact layouts collapse navigation copy, while persisted completion remains separate from capability availability.

The WPF host now uses an isolated native window adapter for AppWindow, title-bar, DPI geometry, and Mica behavior, with opaque system-chrome fallback when capability or accessibility policy disallows the native path.
Default workspaces now prioritize current state, usable measurements, and direct actions while retaining honest unavailable, degraded, privacy, and trust boundaries.
Capture exposes one consented local screenshot action backed by bounded exact-owned storage while recording and replay remain explicit unavailable states.
